# `vox-package`

**Crate:** `vox-package` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Vox package manager: Vox.toml manifests, vox.lock, content-addressed artifact cache, registry client, dependency resolver.

## Crate Overview

Package and schema management for Vox projects (hashing, namespaces, normalized paths, storage).

The `CodeStore` API (**Arca** internal storage) is backed by Turso (libSQL-compatible).
Application code should use **`vox_db::Codex`** / `VoxDb` as the public facade (see ADR 004).


## Features

| Feature | Default / Enables |
|---|---|
| `default` | local |
| `local` | vox-db/local |
| `replication` | vox-db/replication |

## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `artifact_cache` | Content-addressed artifact cache (`.vox-cache`). |
| `bundle` | Content-addressed bundle store for compiled workflow / activity functions (P2-T1). |
| `model_bundle` | SafeTensors model bundle metadata + aggregate CAS hash (Mn-T3). |
| `registry` | HTTP client for the package registry API. |
| `workspace` | Multi-package workspace discovery from `Vox.toml` / members. |
